g.text: More total food intake need not reach more founders
Campaign 017: all 40 historical worlds, with fixed cohorts of 80 founders.
Bars show direct feeding, excluding inherited birth energy. Lifespans and opportunities differ across individuals.
Retrospective accounting; no new independent seeds or causal attribution of extinction.
